title: Gantry-Dispensed Conductive Coating
best_geometry: Open grooves, flat faces, broad tracks and reachable pads
fallback: Return to a manual brush-and-mask baseline, or move to robotic spray only if surface coverage rather than trace precision is the main problem.

title: Robotic Airbrush or Spray Coating
best_geometry: Broad external surfaces, shells and gently curved parts
automation_level: Three-axis spray cell with indexed part rotation
student_recommendation: Useful second method for area coverage
fallback: Use gantry dispensing for selective tracks, or contract a professional coating service when a compliant spray enclosure is unavailable.

title: Automated Electroless Seed Coating
best_geometry: Complex external surfaces and accessible internal passages
automation_level: Supervised wet-process line with timed transfers
fallback: Use direct conductive-filament electroplating for simpler open features, or purchase an electroless seeding service for complex parts.

title: Inkjet-Printed Catalyst or Metal Seed
best_geometry: Fine planar or gently curved traces
fallback: Use gantry dispensing for wider tracks, or aerosol jet printing through a service when non-planar fine features are essential.

title: Aerosol Jet Printed Seed
best_geometry: Fine conformal traces over moderate three-dimensional relief
fallback: Use inkjet for planar fine traces, gantry dispensing for wider conformal traces, or a dual-material conductive filament when resolution is not essential.

title: Laser Direct Structuring
best_geometry: Fine three-dimensional circuits on laser-activatable polymers
automation_level: Enclosed laser activation and electroless line
fallback: Use laser activation of a removable coating, dual-material conductive filament, or a service that accepts ordinary resins if LDS-grade material is unavailable.

title: Flash Ablation Metallization
best_geometry: Exposed conductive-composite faces and shallow traces
fallback: Use direct electroless plating of the conductive composite, mechanical surface preparation, or a lower-energy laser activation service.

title: Physical Vapor Deposition Seed Layer
best_geometry: Thin external line-of-sight coatings and delicate templates
automation_level: Vacuum deposition through a facility or service
student_recommendation: Service-first method for uniform thin seeds
fallback: Use electroless seeding for hidden surfaces, or a sprayed and masked conductive coating when vacuum access or budget is unavailable.

title: Laser-Induced Graphene Seed
automation_level: Enclosed laser writing followed by copper deposition
student_recommendation: Advanced student research with facility laser
fallback: Use a conductive paint, conductive filament or professionally laser-activated metal catalyst when the substrate cannot form stable LIG.

title: Catalyst-Loaded Multi-Material Resin
automation_level: Multi-material vat printing plus electroless plating
student_recommendation: Research thesis extension, not baseline build
fallback: Use commercial conductive filament, a surface-applied seed or an external selective-metallization service rather than formulating active resin.
